title: Web surface bootstrap
priority_action: Build a fresh route and operation inventory from live responses, scripts, specifications, and linked resources; select the highest-impact untested state-changing operation and exercise it with a control pair.
moves: capture the root, redirects, linked resources, and response headers
derive routes and operations from scripts, specifications, forms, and runtime traffic
record parameters, technologies, trust boundaries, and tested controls

title: Identity, role, and object boundaries
priority_action: Choose one consequential authenticated operation and compare owner, peer, lower-role, anonymous, stale, and structurally altered references while preserving a known-valid control.
moves: map identities, roles, tenants, object ownership, and action-level permissions
compare owner, peer, lower-role, anonymous, missing, stale, and malformed references
capture request and response pairs that prove the authorization boundary

title: Session and account lifecycle
priority_action: Trace login, refresh, logout, recovery, enrollment, and identity-change transitions; test whether an old, alternate, or partially completed state retains access to a consequential account action.
moves: trace session creation, renewal, revocation, recovery, and identity changes
compare concurrent, stale, partially completed, and alternate-channel states
prove account impact with the smallest reversible authenticated action

title: Workflow and state transitions
priority_action: Model one high-value workflow as states and invariants, then vary order, repetition, concurrency, stale identifiers, and server-trusted values against a valid baseline.
moves: map valid transitions and server-side invariants
vary order, repetition, concurrency, stale identifiers, and server-trusted values
compare durable state before and after each reversible control pair

title: Server fetch and parser boundaries
priority_action: Locate one server-side URL, webhook, import, preview, proxy, redirect, or document parser and use controlled destinations plus response differentials to establish its trust and network boundary.
moves: inventory URL consumers, callbacks, webhooks, imports, previews, redirects, and document parsers
compare canonical, redirected, encoded, alternate-address, and protocol-shaped inputs
use controlled endpoints and response differentials to prove server-side behavior

title: File and active-content boundaries
priority_action: Trace an upload, export, attachment, archive, media transform, or rendered document from ingestion to retrieval and test whether content type, name, metadata, processing, or access control crosses a higher-impact boundary.
moves: map ingestion, transformation, storage, rendering, and retrieval
vary content signatures, metadata, names, nesting, and retrieval context
prove execution, disclosure, overwrite, or authorization impact with paired evidence

title: Browser origin and cross-site state
priority_action: Select a sensitive browser-mediated action or data response and test origin, preflight, credential, redirect, framing, and cross-window behavior with an authenticated control.
moves: map credentialed cross-origin reads and state changes
compare origin, preflight, redirect, framing, postMessage, and navigation contexts
demonstrate impact in an actual browser session

title: Cache, proxy, and routing boundaries
priority_action: Pick a cacheable or routed response and compare cache keys, host and forwarding metadata, path normalization, authorization context, and intermediary behavior using unique markers and clean controls.
moves: map cache keys, host routing, forwarding metadata, normalization, and authenticated variance
use unique markers and clean controls across intermediary and origin paths
separate one root cause from route variants before recording another case

title: Frontend and runtime intelligence
priority_action: Extract an untested privileged route, hidden operation, schema, feature path, realtime channel, or trust assumption from shipped client artifacts and verify it against the live service.
moves: inspect shipped scripts, maps, manifests, schemas, and runtime requests
extract routes, operations, realtime channels, feature paths, and role assumptions
turn the strongest live lead into a controlled request pair

title: Integrations and delegated trust
priority_action: Trace one OAuth, SSO, invitation, sharing, webhook, support, partner, or delegated-admin flow and test binding of identity, tenant, destination, state, audience, and lifecycle.
moves: inventory delegated identities, invitations, shares, callbacks, partners, and support paths
compare tenant, identity, destination, state, audience, and lifecycle binding
prove cross-boundary access or action with reversible evidence

title: Network service and control-plane inventory
priority_action: Resolve the recorded hosts, identify reachable protocols and alternate service planes, then select one exposed administrative, metadata, datastore, debug, or trust service for protocol-aware validation.
moves: resolve recorded hosts and identify reachable protocols and certificates
enumerate alternate service planes, virtual hosts, administrative paths, and trust relationships
establish protocol grammar with a valid control before testing authorization and exposure

title: Mobile artifact and trust boundaries
priority_action: Inspect the published APK as a binary artifact, extract backend and component trust assumptions, and validate the strongest credential, deep-link, exported-component, storage, or protocol hypothesis against the scoped system.
moves: inspect package metadata, manifest, certificate, resources, assets, and bytecode behavior
map exported components, deep links, local storage, transport, and backend protocols
validate the strongest artifact-derived hypothesis against the scoped system

title: High-severity proof completion
priority_action: Take the highest-severity unresolved candidate, perform the next independent check Astra requested with a positive and negative control, and attach the resulting evidence through revise_finding.
moves: save positive, negative, and fresh-session controls
state preconditions, affected trust boundary, repeatability, and durable impact
attach exact artifacts and revisions for independent Astra grading

title: Operational blocker recovery
priority_action: Resolve the current prerequisite with the available tool inventory, authenticated browser state, a local dependency, or an alternate evidence path, then execute the strongest unblocked high-impact test.
moves: inspect tool inventory and durable authenticated state
satisfy local dependencies and derive alternate evidence paths
resume the strongest high-impact test after resolving the prerequisite
